### Pursuit Announces Date for Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call


October 13, 2026


Conference Call to be Held at 5 p.m. Eastern Time on November 4, 2026


DENVER--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Pursuit Attractions and Hospitality, Inc. (“Pursuit” or the “company”) (NYSE: PRSU), announced today that it plans to release financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 after market close on Wednesday, November 4, 2026 and will host a conference call at 5 p.m. Eastern Time on the same day to review its financial results and provide business updates.


A live audio webcast of the call will be available in listen-only mode through the["Events & Presentations"](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.pursuit.com%2Fevents-and-presentations%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54621314&newsitemid=20261013517100&lan=en-US&anchor=%26quot%3BEvents+%26amp%3B+Presentations%26quot%3B&index=1&md5=983979fbb490823f1b087506a92e51fe) section of Pursuit’s website, where the company will also post its earnings press release and an earnings presentation prior to the call.


The live call can also be accessed by dialing (833) 461-5787 and entering the access code 242 289 230. To avoid wait time and bypass speaking with an operator to join the call, participants can pre-register using the following registration link:[https://events.q4inc.com/analyst/242289230?pwd=cMDIz1t5](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fanalyst%2F242289230%3Fpwd%3DcMDIz1t5&esheet=54621314&newsitemid=20261013517100&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fanalyst%2F242289230%3Fpwd%3DcMDIz1t5&index=2&md5=c254a0199d2dfcfd05de7425f425b2c0) . After registering, a calendar invitation will be sent that includes dial-in information as well as unique codes for entry into the live call. The company recommends that you register in advance to ensure access for the full call.


A replay of the call will be available on Pursuit’s website shortly after the conference call and, for a limited time, by dialing (833) 309-1852 and entering the access code 242 289 230.


**ABOUT PURSUIT**


Pursuit Attractions and Hospitality, Inc. (NYSE: PRSU) is an attractions and hospitality company that owns and operates a collection of inspiring and unforgettable experiences in iconic destinations in the United States, Canada, Iceland, and Costa Rica. Pursuit’s elevated hospitality experiences include world-class point-of-interest attractions and distinctive lodges, along with integrated restaurants, retail and transportation that enable visitors to discover and connect with renowned travel locations.


For more information, visit[pursuit.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.pursuit.com%2F&esheet=54621314&newsitemid=20261013517100&lan=en-US&anchor=pursuit.com&index=3&md5=968605ba63bd591c00e9034fc08b8460) .


**AVAILABILITY OF INFORMATION ON PURSUIT WEBSITE**


Pursuit routinely uses its investor relations website ([investors.pursuit.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.pursuit.com%2F&esheet=54621314&newsitemid=20261013517100&lan=en-US&anchor=investors.pursuit.com&index=4&md5=380ac48829a810f1fee88d4b873b6840) ) to post presentations to investors and other important information, including information that may be material. Accordingly, the company encourages investors and others interested in Pursuit to review the information it makes public on its investor relations website.
